name: The My Bookmarks page in Plugin Pages' host, as admin in the Auto host mode (PageHostMode=Auto at startup, with Plugin Pages installed): GET /PluginPages/User lists Jellyfin.Plugin.Bookmarks.BookmarksPage with its shell URL, the kit chose the Plugin Pages host, the link sits in Plugin Pages' drawer section and not in 'Library tools', the page renders in that host under its own title, a toolbar change keeps the state in the Plugin Pages link (pageUrl plus view=flat), Back and Forward render the grouped and the flat state again from that link (one kit render each), a hard reload of it shows the same state, and after signing out and in again without a reload the page's link is back (Plugin Pages' or, its section gone, ours in Library tools) and opens the page. Needs a sandbox started in Auto mode (Set-SandboxPluginConfig PageHostMode=Auto, then a restart).

steps.name: open the login page

index.html carries Plugin Pages' tag (its startup task registers the File Transformation a few seconds after the server starts, so a check right after a restart waits for it; the kit chooses the host once per page load)
steps.waitFor: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => /<script plugin="PluginPages"/.test(t))

steps.name: reload, so the page has the tag
sign in as admin
the Bookmarks script ran
index.html: the head fragment in Auto mode, the page on, Plugin Pages' tag
steps.eval: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => { const s = t.match(/<script type="application\/json" data-jfbm-head data-jfbm-pages>([^<]*)<\/script>/); return { state: s ? JSON.parse(s[1]) : null, pluginPagesTag: /<script plugin="PluginPages"/.test(t) }; })

steps.name: Auto, bookmarks known and on, Plugin Pages' tag there
GET /PluginPages/User
lists the page's Id and shell URL (registered at startup through Plugin Pages' DI manager)
the kit chose the Plugin Pages host
its link
open the drawer
the link in Plugin Pages' section
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .pluginMenuOptions a[data-itemid="Jellyfin.Plugin.Bookmarks.BookmarksPage"]'); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; })()

steps.name: no 'Library tools' link of ours for it while Plugin Pages shows it
click it
the page renders in Plugin Pages' host under its title
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.userPreferencesPage:not(.hide) [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-mounted][data-jfbm-state="on"]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy')) return false; return { host: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-host'), title: (document.querySelector('.skinHeader .pageTitle') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim(), hash: location.hash, toolbar: !!r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-toolbar'), count: r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-count').textContent }; })()

steps.name: as expected (Plugin Pages' own link leaves pageUrl unencoded; ours encode it)
Flat
the state in the Plugin Pages link
renders before Back
Back
the grouped view again, rendered by the kit from Plugin Pages' own link (one render: the router still holds that location, so no page event comes)
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.userPreferencesPage:not(.hide) [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-mounted][data-jfbm-state="on"]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); if (!r || decodeURIComponent(location.hash) !== '#/userpluginsettings.html?pageUrl=/Bookmarks/Pages/bookmarks') return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || !c.querySelector('.jfbm-group') || !r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-view="grouped"][aria-pressed="true"]')) return false; return { view: 'grouped', host: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-host'), reason: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-reason'), renders: __jfkit.jfbm.instance.pages.state().renders.bookmarks, views: document.querySelectorAll('.userPreferencesPage').length }; })()

steps.name: as expected: the kit's own render, in the same view
Forward
the flat view again, from the link the page wrote (one more render: the view manager loads a view for that URL, which it never had, and its page events render it)
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.userPreferencesPage:not(.hide) [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-mounted][data-jfbm-state="on"]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); if (!r || location.hash !== '#/userpluginsettings.html?pageUrl=%2FBookmarks%2FPages%2Fbookmarks&view=flat') return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || !c.querySelector('.jfbm-row .jfbm-row-item') || !r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-view="flat"][aria-pressed="true"]')) return false; return { view: 'flat', host: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-host'), reason: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-reason'), renders: __jfkit.jfbm.instance.pages.state().renders.bookmarks, views: document.querySelectorAll('.userPreferencesPage').length }; })()

steps.name: as expected: one render, the new view's mount; the view manager keeps the old view

hard reload

steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.userPreferencesPage:not(.hide) [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-mounted][data-jfbm-state="on"]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); if (!r || location.hash !== '#/userpluginsettings.html?pageUrl=%2FBookmarks%2FPages%2Fbookmarks&view=flat') return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy')) return false; return r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-view][aria-pressed="true"]').getAttribute('data-jfbm-view'); })()

steps.name: the page's link is back without a reload: Plugin Pages' (its section added again) or ours in Library tools, to the page in the host the kit chose (Plugin Pages 2.4.7 doesn't add its section again, so the kit's drawer-based decision adds ours, with the Plugin Pages link)
steps.eval: (() => ({ pluginPages: !!document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .pluginMenuOptions a[data-itemid="Jellyfin.Plugin.Bookmarks.BookmarksPage"]'), ours: (a => a ? a.getAttribute('href') : null)(document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .jfkit-nav a[data-jfbm-nav="bookmarks"]')), host: __jfkit.jfbm.instance.pages.state().hosts.bookmarks, href: __jfkit.jfbm.instance.pages.href('bookmarks') }))()

steps.script: const a = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .pluginMenuOptions a[data-itemid="Jellyfin.Plugin.Bookmarks.BookmarksPage"]') || document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .jfkit-nav a[data-jfbm-nav="bookmarks"]'); a.click(); return a.getAttribute('href');

steps.name: the page renders in the host the link names, under its title
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-mounted][data-jfbm-state="on"]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || !c.querySelector('.jfbm-group')) return false; return { host: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-host'), hash: location.hash, title: (document.querySelector('.skinHeader .pageTitle') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim() }; })()
